BEGIN IF NOT EXISTS( SELECT LEGACY_IV_NO FROM KEP_IV WHERE LEGACY_IV_NO = $LEGACY_IV_NO$ AND LEGACY_IV_SEQ = $LEGACY_IV_SEQ$ AND LEGACY_PO_NO = $LEGACY_PO_NO$ AND LEGACY_PO_SEQ = $LEGACY_PO_SEQ$ AND LEGACY_PO_COUNT = $LEGACY_PO_COUNT$ ) BEGIN INSERT INTO KEP_IV( , PLANT , LEGACY_IV_NO , LEGACY_IV_SEQ , STATUS , LEGACY_PO_NO , LEGACY_PO_SEQ , LEGACY_PO_COUNT , BUYER_ITEM_NO , ITEM_QTY , INV_DATE , IF_FLAG , IF_DATE )VALUES( RTRIM($PLANT$), RTRIM($LEGACY_IV_NO$), RTRIM($LEGACY_IV_SEQ$), RTRIM($STATUS$), RTRIM($LEGACY_PO_NO$), RTRIM($LEGACY_PO_SEQ$), RTRIM($LEGACY_PO_COUNT$), RTRIM($BUYER_ITEM_NO$), CAST(ISNULL($ITEM_QTY$,0) AS FLOAT), RTRIM($INV_DATE$), 'N', GETDATE() ) END
ELSE BEGIN UPDATE KEP_IV SET STATUS = RTRIM($STATUS$), ITEM_QTY = CAST(ISNULL($ITEM_QTY$,0) AS FLOAT), INV_DATE = RTRIM($INV_DATE$), IF_FLAG = 'N', IF_DATE = GETDATE() WHERE LEGACY_IV_NO = $LEGACY_IV_NO$ AND LEGACY_IV_SEQ = $LEGACY_IV_SEQ$ AND LEGACY_PO_NO = $LEGACY_PO_NO$ AND LEGACY_PO_SEQ = $LEGACY_PO_SEQ$ AND LEGACY_PO_COUNT= $LEGACY_PO_COUNT$ END END
